records.jp: いいよ！
records.en_original: Sure!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure!
records.en: Sure!

records.jp: ふふ、じゃあいこっか
records.en_original: Hehe. Well let's go, then.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. Well let's go, then.
records.en: Hehe. Then let's go.

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃんにはすっごく感謝してるんだ
records.en_original: I...I'm really grateful for you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I...I'm really grateful for you, Ao.
records.en: ...I'm really grateful to you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: そんな感謝されるようなことした？
records.en_original: Huh? Did I do something?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Did I do something?
records.en: Did I do anything worth thanking me for?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが来てから、色々なことが起こって……<CR>それで、わたしの特別な思い出を取り戻せたから
records.en_original: So much has happened since you came... And I was able to get a special memory of mine back.
records.en_auxiliary: So much has happened since you came... And I was able to get a special memory of mine back.
records.en: So many things have happened since you arrived...<CR>and I was able to recover a precious memory of mine.

records.jp: それって私のおかげってわけでもないと思うけど
records.en_original: I don't think that was necessarily thanks to me, though...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think that was necessarily thanks to me, though...
records.en: I don't think that was necessarily thanks to me, though...

records.jp: でも、ココロトープが現れたのは、愛央ちゃんとの<CR>お話がきっかけだから。愛央ちゃんのおかげなのです
records.en_original: My Heartscape wouldn't have appeared if not for the conversation we had. It's all thanks to you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: My Heartscape wouldn't have appeared if not for the conversation we had. It's all thanks to you, Ao.
records.en: But my Heartscape appeared because of the conversation we had.<CR>So it is thanks to you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: まあ……。<CR>こころがそう言うなら、素直に受け取っておこうかな
records.en_original: Well... If that's how you feel, Kokoro, then I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... If that's how you feel, Kokoro, then I'm glad.
records.en: Well...<CR>If you say so, Kokoro, I guess I'll accept your thanks.

records.jp: ……あれ、伶那さん？　どうかした？
records.en_original: Huh? Rena, what's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Rena, what's wrong?
records.en: Huh? Rena-san, what's wrong?

records.jp: それが、保健室の扉が開かなくて困ってて
records.en_original: I need to get into the nurse's office, but the door won't open.
records.en_auxiliary: I need to get into the nurse's office, but the door won't open.
records.en: The nurse's office door won't open, and I'm not sure what to do.

records.jp: 怪我でもしちゃった？　大丈夫？
records.en_original: Did you hurt yourself? Are you okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you hurt yourself? Are you okay?
records.en: Did you hurt yourself? Are you okay?

records.jp: いや、眠たくてさっきまでここのベッドで<CR>休んでたんだけど、出る時に忘れ物しちゃって
records.en_original: Oh, no. I was just napping on one of the beds earlier and accidentally left something in there.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, no. I was just napping on one of the beds earlier and accidentally left something in there.
records.en: No, I was sleepy, so I was resting in one of the beds here until<CR>just a little while ago, but I forgot something when I left.

records.jp: んー……！　……ホントだ、開かない。<CR>鍵がしまってるのかな？
records.en_original: Hnng! You're right. Is it locked?
records.en_auxiliary: Hnng! You're right. Is it locked?
records.en: Nngh...! ...You're right, it won't open.<CR>Maybe it's locked?

records.jp: 鍵も一応持ってきたけど……どうにも開かないみたいで
records.en_original: I brought the key with me just in case, but I still can't get it open.
records.en_auxiliary: I brought the key with me just in case, but I still can't get it open.
records.en: I brought the key too, just in case...but it still won't open.

records.jp: んー、扉を閉めた拍子に鍵が壊れちゃったのかなあ？
records.en_original: Huh, maybe the lock broke when you closed it?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, maybe the lock broke when you closed it?
records.en: Hmm, maybe the lock broke when you closed the door?

records.jp: ……やっぱり無理やり開けるしかないか
records.en_original: I guess I'll have to force it open.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I'll have to force it open.
records.en: ...I guess I'll have to force it open after all.

records.jp: まあまあ、落ち着いて。<CR>ちょっと助っ人呼んでこよっか
records.en_original: Okay, let's calm down. I'll go and get some help.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, let's calm down. I'll go and get some help.
records.en: Easy, calm down.<CR>Why don't I go get some help?

records.jp: 助っ人……？
records.en_original: Help...?
records.en_auxiliary: Help...?
records.en: Help...?

records.jp: 助っ人参上！
records.en_original: Help has arrived!
records.en_auxiliary: Help has arrived!
records.en: Help has arrived!

records.jp: 勇希ちゃん、手先が器用だから。<CR>鍵とか開けられないかなーって
records.en_original: Yuki is pretty handy, so I figured she'd be able to get the door open.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki is pretty handy, so I figured she'd be able to get the door open.
records.en: Yuki-chan is good at this sort of thing.<CR>I thought she might be able to open the lock.

records.jp: 任しとき。このヘアピンで……
records.en_original: Leave it to me. All I need is this hairpin.
records.en_auxiliary: Leave it to me. All I need is this hairpin.
records.en: Leave it to me. With this hairpin...

records.jp: ……お、開いた
records.en_original: And there we go!
records.en_auxiliary: And there we go!
records.en: ...Oh, it's open.

records.jp: おおー！　すごい！
records.en_original: Ohhh! You did it!
records.en_auxiliary: Ohhh! You did it!
records.en: Ohhh! Amazing!

records.jp: あっはっは！　褒めれ褒めれ
records.en_original: Ahahaha! Shower me with praise!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahahaha! Shower me with praise!
records.en: Ahahaha! Praise me, praise me!

records.jp: ありがとう、勇希ちゃん。助かったよ
records.en_original: Thank you, Yuki! You were a big help.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Yuki! You were a big help.
records.en: Thank you, Yuki-chan. You were a big help.

records.jp: ……一応感謝しとく。靭さんと星崎さんも、<CR>時間とらせて悪かったね
records.en_original: I appreciate it. Sorry to take up your time, Utsubo, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: I appreciate it. Sorry to take up your time, Utsubo, Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...I suppose I should thank you. Utsubo-san, Hoshizaki-san,<CR>sorry for taking up your time too.

records.jp: ううん、いいの。ちゃんと開いて良かったね
records.en_original: Not at all. I'm glad we got it open.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. I'm glad we got it open.
records.en: Not at all. I'm glad we got it open.

records.jp: （……こころ、昔は引っ込み思案で、<CR>　いじめられてたらしいけど……）
records.en_original: (Kokoro used to be so withdrawn before, getting bullied by the other kids...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Kokoro used to be so withdrawn before, getting bullied by the other kids...)
records.en: (I heard Kokoro used to be withdrawn<CR>and was bullied, but...)

records.jp: （今のこころには、そんな面影は全然ない。<CR>　辛い思い出を糧に、頑張って変わったんだろうな）
records.en_original: (But she seems way different now. Maybe all the difficult things she went through drove her to change.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But she seems way different now. Maybe all the difficult things she went through drove her to change.)
records.en: (There's no trace of that in the Kokoro I know now.<CR>She must have worked hard to change, using those painful memories as motivation.)

records.jp: （……今までのこころのこと、もっと知りたい）
records.en_original: (I'd love to get to know Kokoro more.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'd love to get to know Kokoro more.)
records.en: (...I want to know more about everything Kokoro has been through.)
